title: LLM Layers Immediately Correct Each Other
abstract: arXiv:2609.07876v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent methods in language model interpretability employ techniques such as sparse autoencoders to decompose residual stream contributions into linear, semantically meaningful features. Such methods are commonly interpreted as identifying features that persist in the residual stream and that subsequent layers build upon. We challenge this view by identifying the Transformer Layer Correction Mechanism (TLCM), wherein adjacent transformer layers systematically counteract portions of each other's contributions. TLCM appears in 5 out of 7 major open-source model families and activates across nearly all tokens in diverse texts. We show that TLCM emerges during pretraining, operates most strongly on contextually dependent tokens, and adaptively calibrates its correction strength based on the preceding layer's output. translated_title: 大语言模型层间的即时相互修正
translated_abstract: 近期语言模型可解释性研究采用稀疏自编码器等技术，将残差流的贡献分解为线性且具有语义意义的特征。这类方法通常被解读为识别出持续存在于残差流中、并被后续层所构建之上的特征。我们通过识别出Transformer层间修正机制（TLCM）来挑战这一观点：相邻的Transformer层会系统性地抵消彼此贡献中的部分内容。TLCM出现在7个主要开源模型家族中的5个，并在多样化文本中几乎对所有token激活。我们证明TLCM在预训练过程中自然涌现，在依赖上下文的token上作用最强，并能根据前一层的输出自适应地校准其修正强度。利用层雅可比矩阵，我们进一步证明TLCM会选择性地修正特定子空间，同时强化其他子空间，而我们……
tldr: 该研究发现了大语言模型中的“Transformer层间修正机制”（TLCM）：相邻层会系统性地相互抵消并修正对方的输出，这一机制普遍存在于主流开源模型中，在预训练期间涌现，并能根据上下文依赖程度自适应地校准修正强度。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the Transformer Layer Correction Mechanism (TLCM), a phenomenon where adjacent transformer layers in LLMs systematically counteract portions of each other's contributions, prevalent across major open-source model families, emerging during pretraining, and adaptively calibrating its correction strength based on preceding layer outputs.
